title: Grok 4.7 is now available in Kiro
text: Model choice is a core part of how we build Kiro. With Grok 4.7, Kiro now supports models from Anthropic, OpenAI, SpaceXSI, and leading open weight providers, all in one place. A diverse lineup lets you pick for capability, speed, and cost on each task, and keeps your workflow steady as the frontier keeps moving.
